BillingArrangement.name: BillingArrangement
BillingArrangement.description: Represents the arrangement for invoicing a transaction’s billing amount to one or more accounts. The arrangement specifies whether the total amount must be invoiced to the owning account or a different billing account, or whether the invoices must be split among multiple billing accounts.

LastReferencedDate.description: The date the billing arrangement record was last referenced.

LastViewedDate.description: The date the billing arrangement record was last viewed.

Name.description: Required. A user-defined name for the billing arrangement.

OwnerId.description: The ID of the owner of the billing arrangement record.

RemainderBillingPercentage.description: Required. The percentage of the billing amount that isn’t assigned to any of the billing accounts.

ShouldBillRemainderToAccount.description: Indicates whether to bill the remainder billing percentage to the owning account (true) or not (false).

Status.description: Required. Specifies the status of the billing arrangement.

VersionNumber.description: A numerical value indicating the current version of the billing arrangement record. The version number increases when new billing arrangement line records are added or existing billing arrangement line records are updated.
